title: Text typed into the value page's Add form while its save runs is wiped, silently, when the save lands ok
evidence: Seen in the design note for the value page's Add untangle (D5, the owner's pick (a): leave as today, logged here). While a save is out only Add is disabled (widget-src/src/components/ValuePage.tsx, AddValue: disabled={form.kind === 'saving'}); the Date and Value fields stay editable. On ok, add() clears the text, the diastolic and the day (setText(''); setDia(''); setDate(today)), so anything typed after the press is lost with no word. Not seen by a person; read from the code. Remedies, each a visible change: (b) make the fields read-only while saving (keeps focus and the phone keyboard); (c) keep text typed after the save was sent when it lands.
